gaez.title: GAEZ crop suitability
gaez.advisory: Independent context only. These ratings do not change scores or remove crops.
gaez.scope: Low confidence: a single grid cell around the Sétif story field, not a field measurement or a rating for the whole high plains.
gaez.conditions.low: Rainfed, low-input comparison under historical AgERA5 climate. This is a comparison scenario, not a management recommendation.
gaez.conditions.high: Rainfed, high-input comparison under historical AgERA5 climate. This is a comparison scenario, not a management recommendation.
gaez.location: Sample point: {lat}, {lon}. The rating describes the grid cell containing this point.
gaez.rating: {crop}: GAEZ rates this crop {rating} in the sampled story-field cell.
gaez.unavailable: {crop}: GAEZ suitability is not available for this crop or mixture.
gaez.outside: {crop}: no GAEZ rating has been sampled for this field. The story-field rating does not apply here.
gaez.risk: Risk needing local review: check this modelled suitability with a local agronomist.
credits.role.gaez_v5: Independent crop suitability context at the Sétif story-field cell; rainfed comparison only, never a filter or score.
validation.cross.title: Weather, water and county-yield cross-checks
validation.cross.intro: Each comparison uses the overlapping observations available for each sampling area. Missing sources stay visible. The three nearby areas share county records and can share coarse weather pixels; they are not independent validation sites.
validation.cross.openet: Monthly water use: modeled ET vs. OpenET
validation.cross.quickstats: Season scores vs. county wheat yields
validation.cross.directional: Directional context only, not a yield forecast. County yields include all farming practices. Scores come from a fixed continuous winter-wheat counterfactual with default soil, equal priorities and no irrigation; they do not reconstruct each area's actual crop history.
validation.cross.etCaveat: ET is modeled actual evapotranspiration for the same continuous winter-wheat counterfactual, summed by calendar month. The initialization year and months with filled temperature or rainfall are excluded. OpenET is another satellite-driven model estimate, not measured ground truth.
validation.cross.rainCaveat: Rain totals cover complete September–August agricultural years, labeled by harvest year. Official IMERG Final monthly mean rates are multiplied by the hours in each calendar month; all twelve monthly totals must be present. This compares two rainfall products, not the POWER rainfall used by this replay. IMERG Final and PRISM both incorporate rain gauges and may share observations.
validation.cross.missing_imerg: Not compared: these bundles contain NASA POWER rainfall and no IMERG series. POWER has not been relabeled as IMERG.
validation.cross.openet_key_required: Not compared: the OpenET API requires a free account key, and no authenticated capture is available.
validation.cross.noOverlap: No complete overlapping observations are available.
validation.cross.coverage: {count} paired periods; {unmatched} unmatched periods excluded. Reference has {reference} usable periods.
validation.cross.errorMetrics: Bias (ITZA minus reference): {bias} mm. Root mean square error: {rmse} mm.
validation.cross.rank: Spearman rank correlation: {rho}. At least three pairs and variation in both series are required.
validation.cross.direction: Year-on-year direction agrees in {agree} of {total} non-tied adjacent-year changes; {ties} tied changes excluded. Missing years are not bridged.
validation.cross.unitsWater: Both columns are water depth in millimeters.
validation.cross.unitsYield: ITZA is a unitless season score; reference is county winter wheat yield in bushels per harvested acre. Values are compared by rank and direction only.
validation.cross.rainErrorMetrics: Bias (IMERG minus PRISM): {bias} mm. Root mean square error: {rmse} mm.
